summary: Sanctioned minimal output sample & redaction test access for regulatory fraud inquiry
description:
Issue summary: Customer regulator-equivalent has submitted a fraud inquiry for a set of customer sessions. Legal requests a small, fully redacted sample of inference outputs plus a one-time redaction test run to validate our automated scrubbers.

Background: A regulatory body is evaluating a potential fraud pattern in transactions tied to account hashes. We have agreement from Legal and Privacy to provide minimized evidence for their review, but only after technical controls are validated. This ticket coordinates a timeboxed, read-only extraction of tokenized outputs and a redaction verification job.

Request: 1) Provision ephemeral, read-only access for SRE/Privacy to run a redaction test against a 200-session random sample (seeded by the provided session IDs). 2) Generate output artifacts: raw token sequences (token IDs only), redaction logs (pattern matches, rule IDs), and a fully redacted human-readable sample (PII replaced with <REDACTED>). 3) All artifacts must be stored encrypted, KMS-wrapped, and deleted after certification. 4) Runbook: record commands, PRs, and checksums; capture timestamps and approver list.

Justification: Legal has approved scope-limited disclosure for investigative purposes. Privacy requires validation that our scrubbers remove account numbers and named entities before any human review. Security requires ephemeral access with MFA and session logging for audit.

Data minimization plan: - Sampling: deterministic sample of 200 sessions provided by Legal (list attached in Confluence). - Tokenization: provide only token IDs and hashed session identifiers for RAW sample. - Redacted sample: provide human-readable outputs with reversible elements masked and a redact-certification signature. - Access window: 48 hours from approval.

Access controls & technical constraints: - No raw plaintext customer messages will leave the VPC. - All artifacts remain in the prod-us-east isolated bucket with kms:key-arn set to arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/prod-redaction-key. - Access via bastion for SRE/Privacy only; disable after window. - Audit trail to be exported to SIEM.

Approval checklist: - Legal ack: present (Sara Goldstein) - Privacy ack: pending (Privacy review required) - SRE scheduling and runbook owner assigned: Lina Chen - Security ack for KMS & bastion: James Ortega - Data retention & deletion verification: Compliance automation to run post-delete.

Success criteria / Done: - Redaction test run completes with zero high-risk escapes for account numbers or email-like tokens. - Artifacts produced and validated by Privacy. - Deletion confirmation recorded and signed-off by Compliance.

Attachments and artifacts: See related Confluence page for session list and runbook template. Also link to PR for redaction rule updates in infra repo.

Next steps: - Lina to confirm time window and test runner (expected by 2026-03-12). - Privacy to provide acceptance criteria and regex/rule whitelist. - Security to create ephemeral IAM role and key policy changes.
